description: Generate ready-to-sign EVM transactions and EIP-5792 atomic batch calls for a zero-net-cost payment on Base (Chain ID 8453). Automatically supplies collateral into Aave V3 or Morpho to recover 100% of the principal + developer fee.

amount.description: Amount of USDC to pay to the recipient (e.g. 25).

protocol.description: Yield protocol to use ('auto', 'aave', or 'morpho'). Defaults to 'auto'.

recipient.description: Ethereum address of the recipient receiving the payment (0x...).

sender.description: Ethereum address of the payer executing the transactions (0x...).

name: build_payment

batchCalls.description: EIP-5792 atomic batch calls array for Smart Accounts and Agentic Wallets

chainId.description: Target EVM Chain ID (8453 for Base)

summary.description: Detailed financial summary of the zero-cost payment plan

poolAddress.description: Aave V3 Pool or Morpho Vault contract address

totalRequiredAmount.description: Total capital required upfront in USDC

yieldDepositAmount.description: Deposit into yield vault in USDC

transactions.description: Ordered array of 4 sequential EVM transactions for standard wallets

name.description: Action name (e.g. DEVELOPER_FEE, RECIPIENT_PAYMENT, APPROVE_POOL, SUPPLY_COLLATERAL)
